scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/metaport build
scripts.build:mainnet: bun run build:packages && NETWORK_NAME=mainnet bash scripts/build.sh
scripts.build:testnet: bun run build:packages && NETWORK_NAME=testnet bash scripts/build.sh
scripts.build:base-sepolia-testnet: bun run build:packages && NETWORK_NAME=base-sepolia-testnet bash scripts/build.sh
scripts.build:base: bun run build:packages && NETWORK_NAME=base bash scripts/build.sh
scripts.build:qa: bun run build:packages && NETWORK_NAME=legacy bash scripts/build.sh
scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -k -n CORE,METAPORT,PORTAL -c cyan,magenta,green 'bun run --cwd packages/core dev' 'bun run --cwd packages/metaport dev' 'bun run dev:portal'
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/metaport
